latest.title: BioShock Classic for Android v0.2.1-dev
latest.notes:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.2-dev:

## Changes and fixes

- Added crash reports with a copy-to-clipboard button. Reports are saved under `BioShock/crashes` and include the game log, build information and available native crash details. Crash monitoring can be disabled in the launcher.
- Fixed a buffer overflow when taking research-camera photos. Vulkan and OpenGL ES now respect the source and destination regions and resize the captured image to 256 x 256.
- Added movement-stick settings for the dead zone, visibility and fixed position.
- Added a slide-out weapon and plasmid inventory bar for the Port touch layout. Its **Weapon selection: On/Off** toggle is on **Input and prompts**. Weapon swipes now use a larger threshold and a rate limit for more controlled selection.
- Made the map and journal use interfaces that support both touch and gamepad input.
- Added launcher cleanup options for unused installation files and rebuildable caches. Limited diagnostic log growth and removed stale shader cache entries.
- Added a **PanVK: linear window buffers** option, enabled by default, to address blank or corrupted output on some Mali devices. It applies to bundled and imported PanVK drivers.
- Moved injected cheat and diagnostic commands to the game's message pump, fixing the reproduced PlasmiNow movie crash caused by running a command inside the Bink decoder. Added movie-copy guards, improved Bink diagnostics and made Russian audio-track selection check the available sound tracks.

## Requirements and installation

- ARM64 Android 8.0 or later, with OpenGL ES 3.2. Vulkan requires Vulkan 1.1, or Vulkan 1.0 with `VK_KHR_maintenance1`. Bundled Turnip and PanVK require Android 11 or later and compatible GPUs.
- Your own copy of **BioShock Classic for Windows, patch 1.1, GOG build 127339** is required separately. Remastered game data is not supported.
- Download and sideload the APK below, select the game folder containing `Builds/` and `Content/` in the launcher, then press **Play**. A SHA-256 file is included for verification.
- Application version: **0.2.1-dev**, Android version code **4**.

## Verification and known limitations

- The targeted host suite ran 68 tests: 67 passed and one was skipped. All 24 targeted settings and touch-control tests passed after the weapon-toggle update.
- Native ARM64 compilation, APK v2/v3 signatures, alignment, version metadata, archive integrity and packaged runtime identity were checked.
- This exact release APK has not been play-tested on a device; earlier candidates were tested on Android. Device, driver and full-campaign coverage remains limited.
- The original player-reported PlasmiNow crash on an Adreno/Turnip device remains unlocalized. The reproduced command-injection crash is fixed, and the new crash reports provide better evidence for diagnosing remaining failures.

Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.1.1-dev:

## Performance and rendering

- Moved Vulkan pipeline and OpenGL ES program warm-up to low-priority background workers, with a larger seed recorded across all 15 levels. Cached results are reused on later starts.
- Reduced loading stalls through fairer thread handoffs, background logging and memory cleanup, texture read-ahead, and caching repeated missing-file checks.
- Removed redundant Vulkan buffer bindings and OpenGL ES state changes. Fixed compressed-texture uploads and preserved the aspect ratio when changing render resolution.
- Fixed first-person weapon and arm framing on wide screens while preserving world FOV, weapon FOV, and zoom settings.
- Updated bundled PanVK; compatible Mali devices can now use it on Android 11 or later. Added an Adreno 618 workaround for GPU loss with bundled Turnip.
- Renderer startup failures and device/context loss now return to the launcher with a reason and an offer to select another renderer.
- ADPF is now off by default.

## Controls and interface

- Improved direct touch camera movement and separated finger input from gyro input. Improved gamepad detection, Xbox/PlayStation button glyphs, and prompts for switching between touch and external controls.
- Reworked iPhone/iPad layouts: stable stick size and position, larger touch targets, separate interaction buttons, and working Jump, Aim/zoom, audio-log, and Map actions.
- Restored iOS-style weapon/plasmid selection: tap Next to cycle, or hold and drag to choose an owned alternative. The active category button fires; the inactive category switches on release. Reload replenishes EVE in plasmid mode.
- Corrected iOS HUD anchors, ammo display and ammo switching. Removed duplicate selection elements and stray ammo counts. Temporary Android system bars no longer resize the controls.
- Fixed Back/Escape/Start handling, settings navigation, Apply behavior, and large-interface layouts. Added Back buttons to stock settings pages and restored the Graphics entry in additional settings.
- Added an optional cheat menu with invulnerability, health/EVE restoration, money, weapons/ammo, plasmids, and movement commands. Enable cheats in the additional game settings, then open Pause.

## Requirements and installation

- ARM64 Android 8.0 or later; OpenGL ES 3.2 is the default renderer. Bundled Turnip and PanVK require Android 11 or later and compatible GPUs.
- Your own copy of **BioShock Classic for Windows, patch 1.1, GOG build 127339** is required separately.
- Download and sideload the APK below, select the game folder containing `Builds/` and `Content/` in the launcher, then press **Play**. A SHA-256 file is included for download verification.

## Verification

83 host tests passed, including 210 layout combinations and 714 weapon-projection cases. APK signing, ARM64 packaging, 16 KB alignment, shader assets, and original iOS sprite hashes were verified. This exact release APK has not been play-tested on a device; earlier candidates were tested on Android. Physical iPhone/iPad hardware and gamepad rumble motors were not tested.

Second development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic.

## Controls and interface

- Added iPhone and iPad touch layouts alongside the port layout and a hidden-controls mode. The iOS layouts use 52 original sprites, including eight weapon icons and 22 plasmid icons. They show the equipped weapon and plasmid, the active slot, crouch or stand state, and the alternate reload icon in plasmid mode.
- Added a 50–200% iOS control scale and context-sensitive Hack, Rescue, and Harvest buttons. Control groups scale together and the left group accounts for the health and ammo HUD. Map and Pause activate on release over the same button.
- Kept movement and camera gestures available with the overlay hidden. Fixed absolute touch coordinates at screen edges and input recovery after graphics changes or a stalled input event.
- Added phone vibration for in-game rumble and touch feedback, with an on/off switch and strength adjustment in 25% steps.
- Added optional touch aim assist using BioShock's controller aim system. Each touch sample is consumed once, and direct touch look remains available when the game's aim properties are unavailable.
- Added physical-controller navigation to the original Pause menu with the D-pad, left stick, confirm, cancel, and Start. Improved right-stick axis detection and added contextual Xbox and PlayStation HUD prompts. Fixed settings row focus, hidden hit targets, and FOV slider dragging.

## Rendering, loading, and audio

- Synchronized fullscreen DXGI window dimensions with the back buffer and fixed the buffer-count field on resize.
- OpenGL ES now loads cached program binaries before linking remaining startup programs. Fixed texture unbinding for non-2D targets and excluded invalid GPU timer samples.
- Vulkan prefers MAILBOX presentation on supported Mali drivers and falls back to FIFO. Swapchain images have separate presentation resources and completion semaphores, and presentation waits are recorded in frame statistics.
- Added a material shader lookup cache that validates identity and timestamps, and handled shader token allocation failure.
- Added background read-ahead for streamed bulk-content ranges in folders, ZIPs, and OBBs. Blocking reads yield to other game threads, and I/O timing excludes the wait to re-enter the game runtime.
- An overdue audio worker can move ahead of the normal queue for one turn. The next handoff restores the normal order.

## Launcher and diagnostics

- Expanded the game-mode tip beyond Xiaomi HyperOS to Samsung, realme, OPPO, OnePlus, vivo, iQOO, and HONOR. The About screen controls whether the tip appears. The shared launcher also gained extension points for ZIP selection, option editors, and pre-launch prompts.
- Added a Crash monitoring switch, enabled by default. The active profile keeps `bioshock.log` and logs from the two preceding sessions. The game reports the log's location when logging is enabled.
- OBB split builds now inherit the base APK version. The repository includes the GPLv3 license and documents how to prepare the iOS control sprites for a local build.

## Requirements and installation

- ARM64 Android 8.0 or later. OpenGL ES 3.2 is the default renderer. See the repository README for Vulkan and driver requirements.
- A separate copy of **BioShock Classic for Windows, patch 1.1, GOG build 127339**. Copy its `Builds/` and `Content/` folders to the device, select the game folder under **Game data**, then press **Play**.
- Download and sideload the APK below. The accompanying SHA-256 file can be used to verify the download.

## Verification

The APK signature, ARM64 package, and all 52 bundled iOS sprites were verified. Sixty host tests passed. One Android-device test was skipped, and this exact APK has not been play-tested on a device.

First development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. The port uses ahead-of-time recompilation of the original Windows x86 code.

## Features

- OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan rendering, with bundled Turnip and PanVK options for compatible GPUs.
- Touch controls, gamepad input, and configurable controls.
- Launcher with folder and ZIP game-data import, renderer selection, optional texture conversion, and update checks.

## Requirements and installation

- An ARM64 Android device running Android 8.0 or later. OpenGL ES 3.2 is the default renderer. See the repository README for Vulkan and driver requirements.
- Your own installation of **BioShock Classic for Windows, patch 1.1, GOG build 127339**. The original game files are required separately.
- Sideload the APK. Copy your Classic game folder to the device with its `Builds/` and `Content/` directories, then select that folder under **Game data** in the launcher and press **Play**.

## Known limitations

Device, driver, and full-campaign testing is limited in this development release.
